text.description_html:
Grade 1 Full Cover Door Closer

The Global TC512 door closer offers a full variety of features which allow adjustments to meet the varied conditions of almost any door control installation. This large door closer is great for use on commercial, architectural and institutional door applications. Available in Aluminum or Dark Bronze finish.

Global TC512 door closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and adjustable backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 12" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features of the Global TC512 Door Closer:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 12"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 2-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Includes full plastic cover (fully covers closer body)
  • UL 10C Approved for positive pressure
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 25 Year Manufacture Warranty

***THIS ITEM IS DISCONTINUED, ONLY 1 DARK BRONZE LEFT IN STOCK
